structure: Colorado Academic Standards, Social Studies P-12 (adopted 2022). Pages 1-9 are front matter (committee lists, purpose, revision process, how-to-read) = backup; page 6 lists the 8 Prepared Graduate statements for all grades (standards, grades all). Standards pages 10-145 are organized by grade (Preschool, Kindergarten, First-Eighth Grade) and one High School band (no courses, grades 9-12), each with Standard 1 History, 2 Geography, 3 Economics, 4 Civics, 5 Personal Financial Literacy. Each page header 'SOCIAL STUDIES <Grade>, Standard N. <Name>' is followed by 'Prepared Graduates', 'Grade Level Expectation' (GLE, code SS.<grade>.<std>.<n>, e.g. SS.K.1.1, SS.HS.1.2; the code appears as a separate unit near the page end) and 'Students Can:' (Evidence Outcomes a, b, c...) = standards. Right-hand 'Academic Context and Connections' = Colorado Essential Skills, Inquiry Questions, Nature and Skills of <discipline>, Disciplinary, Information, and Media Literacy = examples. Preschool pages use 'Preschool Learning and Development Expectation', 'Indicators of Progress' (standards) and 'Examples of High-Quality Teaching and Learning Experiences' (Supportive Teaching Practices / Examples of Learning, labeled examples); Preschool -> grade PK. Each GLE spans 1-2 PDF pages (second page has only ACC continuation, running header lacks the grade). Two-column layout is interleaved in extraction; continuation fragments were classified by x-position (x=68/428 = Students Can wrap) and leading numbering (digit-dot = ACC list, letter-dot = Evidence Outcome). The repeated '<Grade>, Standard N. <Name>' (x=108) at the end of each page is a page footer heading, labeled backup.
